title: YouTube Search with FlashData
description: Get your FlashData API key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys (sign in or create an account first). Enter the required query input and your own FlashData API key below. Optional settings can be left unchanged. Click Start to run one YouTube Search request, then open the run’s Dataset for results or OUTPUT for the complete JSON response. FlashData Credits and Apify resource usage are billed separately; no Actor service fee is added.

query.title: Query
query.description: Enter one YouTube Search search query, for example: battery recycling explained. One query is sent per run; do not paste a list of queries.

flashdataApiKey.title: Your FlashData API key
flashdataApiKey.description: Get your key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys (sign in or create an account first), then create or copy a key with YouTube Search (youtube_search) permission. Paste the full key starting with fd_ here, without quotes or a Bearer prefix. Use your own FlashData key, not your Apify token. This field is encrypted; no working key is provided. Clicking Start uses your FlashData Credits.

max_results.title: Max Results
max_results.description: Number of results to request (1–20; default 20). Actual count may be lower.
max_results.sectionDescription: The required inputs above are enough for a first run. Change these settings only when your workflow needs them.

filters.title: Filters
filters.description: Optional JSON filters. Example: {"upload_date":"this_week","sort_by":"view_count","type":"video"}. Leave empty for no explicit filters. Accepted values are listed in the README; do not paste a search URL.
